##** Actigram
```{r}

# ==========================================
# 1. Load and Filter Data
# ==========================================
# Assuming 'CorsanoAnalysismulti' is loaded in your R environment
df <- CorsanoAnalysismulti %>%
  filter(Subject == Subject3)

# DATA CHECK:
if("Steps" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- rename(df, activity = Steps)
} else {
  stop("Column 'Steps' not found. Please ensure the dataframe has a 'Steps' column.")
}

# ==========================================
# 2. Data Processing for Double Plotting
# ==========================================
# Logic Update:
# The 'Time' column is cumulative (e.g., 27.0 = 3 AM on Day 2).
# We need to extract the 0-24h time and the Day Index mathematically.

actigram_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Ensure Time is numeric
    raw_time = as.numeric(Time),
    
    # Calculate Day Index: 
    # Time 0-24 is Day 1, 24-48 is Day 2, etc.
    # floor(raw_time / 24) gives 0 for Day 1, 1 for Day 2. We add 1 to make it 1-based.
    day_index = floor(raw_time / 24) + 1,
    
    # Calculate Time of Day (0-24h):
    # Use modulo operator %% to get the remainder after dividing by 24.
    time_hours = raw_time %% 24
  ) 

# ==========================================
# 2.1 Normalize Day Index
# ==========================================
# If the dataset starts on Day 5 (e.g., hours start > 96), this shifts it back to start at Day 1.
min_day <- min(actigram_data$day_index, na.rm = TRUE)

if (min_day > 1) {
  # Subtract (X - 1) from all values so the sequence starts at 1
  actigram_data$day_index <- actigram_data$day_index - (min_day - 1)
}

# Create the "Left" panel (Day N, 0-24 hours)
left_panel <- actigram_data %>%
  mutate(plot_x = time_hours,
         plot_y = day_index)

# Create the "Right" panel (Day N+1, 24-48 hours)
# We shift the time by +24, and shift the 'day association' back by 1.
# This means data from Day 2 (Day Index 2) will appear on Day 1's row (Plot Y 1), but at hours 24-48.
right_panel <- actigram_data %>%
  mutate(plot_x = time_hours + 24,
         plot_y = day_index - 1) %>%
  filter(plot_y >= 1)

# Combine them into one plotting dataset
plot_df <- bind_rows(left_panel, right_panel)

# ==========================================
# 3. Plotting with ggplot2
# ==========================================

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = plot_x, y = plot_y)) +
  geom_rect(aes(
    xmin = plot_x, 
    xmax = plot_x + 0.25, # Width of ~15 min interval. Adjust if your data frequency differs.
    # To make bars go "UP" visually on a reversed Y-axis, we must SUBTRACT height from the baseline
    ymin = plot_y - (activity / max(activity, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.9, 
    ymax = plot_y 
  ), fill = "black") +
  
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = unique(plot_df$plot_y),
    labels = paste("Day", unique(plot_df$plot_y))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 48, by = 6),
    labels = c("00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "00:00"),
    limits = c(0, 48)
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Double-Plotted Actigram",
    subtitle = "Showing 48-hour window per row (Time cumulative)",
    x = "Time of Day (Hours)",
    y = "Relative Day"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray80") 
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 24, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.5)

```



#** Actigram with overlay
```{r}
# ==========================================
# 1. Load and Filter Data
# ==========================================
df <- CorsanoAnalysismulti %>%
  filter(Subject == Subject3)

# DATA CHECK: Steps
if("Steps" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- rename(df, activity = Steps)
} else {
  stop("Column 'Steps' not found.")
}

# DATA CHECK: CBT (Red)
if("CBT" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- rename(df, temp = CBT)
} else {
  warning("Column 'CBT' not found. Creating empty column.")
  df$temp <- NA
}

# DATA CHECK: HR (Blue)
if("HR" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- rename(df, hr = HR)
  # Treat 0 as missing data so the line breaks instead of dipping
  df$hr[df$hr == 0] <- NA
} else {
  warning("Column 'HR' not found. Creating empty column.")
  df$hr <- NA
}

# DATA CHECK: HRV (Green)
if("HRV" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- rename(df, hrv = HRV)
} else {
  warning("Column 'HRV' not found. Creating empty column.")
  df$hrv <- NA
}

# DATA CHECK: Breath (Purple)
if("Breath" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- rename(df, breath = Breath)
} else {
  warning("Column 'Breath' not found. Creating empty column.")
  df$breath <- NA
}

# ==========================================
# 2. Data Processing for Double Plotting
# ==========================================

actigram_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    raw_time = as.numeric(Time),
    day_index = floor(raw_time / 24) + 1,
    time_hours = raw_time %% 24
  ) 

# ==========================================
# 2.1 Normalize Day Index
# ==========================================
min_day <- min(actigram_data$day_index, na.rm = TRUE)
if (min_day > 1) {
  actigram_data$day_index <- actigram_data$day_index - (min_day - 1)
}

# ==========================================
# 2.2 Calculate Scaling Factors
# ==========================================
# We need global min/max to normalize the data to fit inside the rows (0-1 height)
max_act <- max(actigram_data$activity, na.rm = TRUE)

# CBT Scaling
min_temp <- min(actigram_data$temp, na.rm = TRUE)
max_temp <- max(actigram_data$temp, na.rm = TRUE)
temp_range <- max_temp - min_temp
if (is.na(temp_range) || temp_range == 0) temp_range <- 1 

# HR Scaling
#min_hr <- min(actigram_data$hr, na.rm = TRUE)
min_hr <- 50
max_hr <- max(actigram_data$hr, na.rm = TRUE)
hr_range <- max_hr - min_hr
if (is.na(hr_range) || hr_range == 0) hr_range <- 1 

# HRV Scaling
min_hrv <- min(actigram_data$hrv, na.rm = TRUE)
max_hrv <- max(actigram_data$hrv, na.rm = TRUE)
hrv_range <- max_hrv - min_hrv
if (is.na(hrv_range) || hrv_range == 0) hrv_range <- 1 

# Breath Scaling
min_breath <- min(actigram_data$breath, na.rm = TRUE)
max_breath <- max(actigram_data$breath, na.rm = TRUE)
breath_range <- max_breath - min_breath
if (is.na(breath_range) || breath_range == 0) breath_range <- 1 

# ==========================================
# 2.3 Create Panels
# ==========================================

# Create the "Left" panel (Day N, 0-24 hours)
left_panel <- actigram_data %>%
  mutate(plot_x = time_hours,
         plot_y = day_index)

# Create the "Right" panel (Day N+1, 24-48 hours)
# Shift time by +24, shift day index back by 1
right_panel <- actigram_data %>%
  mutate(plot_x = time_hours + 24,
         plot_y = day_index - 1) %>%
  filter(plot_y >= 1)

# Combine
plot_df <- bind_rows(left_panel, right_panel)

# ==========================================
# 3. Plotting with ggplot2
# ==========================================

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = plot_x, y = plot_y)) +
  # 1. Activity Bars (Black)
  geom_rect(aes(
    xmin = plot_x, 
    xmax = plot_x + 0.25, 
    ymin = plot_y - (activity / max_act) * 0.9, 
    ymax = plot_y 
  ), fill = "black") + # Added alpha to bars to make lines more visible
  
  # 2. CBT Line (Red)
  geom_line(aes(
    group = plot_y,
    y = plot_y - ((temp - min_temp) / temp_range) * 0.9
  ), color = "red", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +

  # 3. HR Line (Blue)
  geom_line(aes(
    group = plot_y,
    y = plot_y - ((hr - min_hr) / hr_range) * 1.25
  ), color = "blue", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +

  # 4. HRV Line (Green)
#  geom_line(aes(
#    group = plot_y,
#    y = plot_y - ((hrv - min_hrv) / hrv_range) * 0.9
#  ), color = "green", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +

  # 5. Breath Line (Purple)
#  geom_line(aes(
#    group = plot_y,
#    y = plot_y - ((breath - min_breath) / breath_range) * 0.9
#  ), color = "purple", size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = unique(plot_df$plot_y),
    labels = paste("Day", unique(plot_df$plot_y))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 48, by = 6),
    labels = c("00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "00:00"),
    limits = c(0, 48)
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Double-Plotted Actigram with Overlays",
    #subtitle = "Bars=Steps | Red=CBT | Blue=HR | Green=HRV | Purple=Breath (All Normalized)",
    subtitle = "Bars=Steps | Red=CBT | Blue=HR (All Normalized)",
    x = "Time of Day (Hours)",
    y = "Relative Day"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray80") 
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 24, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.3)
```
